suggestions.title: Protect sleep: aim 7.5 h, cap afternoon caffeine

rationale.science: At equal deficits, 5.5 vs 8.5 h sleep cut fat loss 55% and raised lean-mass loss 60% (Nedeltcheva 2010).
rationale.data: Last 13 nights average 7.3 h (7-night debt 1 h); 5 recent days had >=300 mg or afternoon caffeine.
rationale.relationship: Short sleep + late caffeine track with your low recovery score and rep dips - the lever that protects lean while you cut.

suggestions.predict: Higher share of loss as fat; lean protected; better session quality.
